title: A stranger just texted you a photo of your front door
style: Warm painterly 2D cartoon illustration, cinematic graphic-novel look: clean bold dark outlines, rich textured digital painting, soft volumetric light, deep warm oranges and moody blues, detailed environment, vertical 9:16 composition.
character: MAIN CHARACTER: a lanky ADULT man drawn as a minimalist cartoon: a perfectly round smooth tan head, two tiny solid black dot eyes set wide apart, short thin eyebrow strokes, a very small simple mouth, no nose, no visible hair, simple long limbs, dark charcoal baseball cap, oversized heather-grey hoodie, black slim pants, white sneakers. Minimal face like a webcomic, not a child, not anime, no big eyes.

scenes.A: Night, the man sits on a couch in a dim apartment, face lit by his phone, warm lamp, rain on the window, uneasy.

B.prompt: First-person point of view from the viewer's own eyes: no face, no head and no full body visible, only the viewer's own two cartoon hands in grey hoodie sleeves reaching in from the bottom of the frame. The hands hold a smartphone showing a dark blurry photo of an apartment front door with a brass number plate, warm hallway light, the real door visible behind the phone.

scenes.C: The man presses his ear against the inside of his apartment front door, listening, hallway light leaking under the door, tense.
scenes.D: View through a door peephole: big circular fisheye frame with a dark metal ring border, an empty dim apartment hallway with flickering ceiling light, nobody there.
scenes.E: The man carefully opens his front door a crack, a small cardboard box sits on the doormat outside, dim hallway.

F.prompt: First-person point of view from the viewer's own eyes: no face, no head and no full body visible, only the viewer's own two cartoon hands in grey hoodie sleeves reaching in from the bottom of the frame. The hands open a small cardboard box revealing an old silver key and a folded handwritten note, on a wooden kitchen table, lamp light.

scenes.G: The man stares at his own front door from across the room, holding a silver key, worried, shadows, rain on window.
scenes.H: Close-up portrait of the man facing the viewer, uncertain worried look, dark apartment behind him with warm lamp glow.

segments.text: A stranger just texted you a photo of your own front door.
Then another message. Don't open it yet.
You press your ear to the door. Nothing.
You check the peephole. The hallway is empty.
Your phone buzzes again. Now you can.
A small box is sitting on your doormat.
Inside, a key. And a note.
And then you realize. That's the empty apartment across the hall.
Do you use the key? Or call someone first?
Stick or twist? Comment below. Part two decides.
